text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen has 
arrived. People are buzzing with 
excitement over Neo Universe's unexpected 
entry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other runners are all seasoned 
competitors from older generations. Yet 
among them, the one Neo Universe is paying 
the most attention to is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That Umamusume" who said she wanted to 
"make contact" —Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And someone seems to know what Neo 
Universe wants to do— Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What kind of effect will her "connection" 
with the two of them have on Neo Universe?
